units.source_text: 美代说：“今天，我把前些日子去占卜的情况告诉了他，他就说：太好了，

en.t: Miyo said, "Today, I told him about going to have my fortune told the other day, and he said, 'That is wonderful,

units.source_text: 那时候我仿佛记得好像什么东西都是两口就吃掉了，

en.t: at that time, as I remember it, it seemed as though I could eat anything in just two bites,

units.source_text: 喝嘛，也是多少都能喝下去。”

en.t: and as for drinking, I could drink any amount at all.'"
